name: addressed-via-rewrite

openThread.title: Hardcoded workspace path
openThread.description: The workspace root is hardcoded to `/Users/runner/work/project`. Use `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` instead.
openThread.suggestedFix: Replace the hardcoded path with `WORKSPACE=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)`.
openThread.currentCode:
3: set -euo pipefail

   5: # Determine workspace root
>>>6: WORKSPACE="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
   7: cd "$WORKSPACE"
   8: ./bin/codecov upload
